annotations.title: Why the leads are dear or ran out

description: The criteria revision («Изменить критерии»): while a search asks about a higher price, or when a finished search ran out of people, works out which criteria hold it back and proposes changes, each combination with its price in credits and the leads it may give. Takes up to ~75 s. Then revise_search with the chosen proposal ids. [REST: POST /api/tasks/{id}/revise/diagnose]

task_id.description: The search id (task id), e.g. from list_searches or create_search.
